title: Publish native local-Dactyl SQLite runtime preflight
intent: When a Decapod project uses backend=local, agentic startup must resolve a usable host SQLite shared library for Dactyl. It must honor DACTYL_SQLITE_LIBRARY or the machine-local Decapod runtime config, discover and persist a usable host path at the OS/user level when possible, and otherwise return concise installation and export instructions. Cloud-backed startup must not require or probe SQLite.
proof_hooks: cargo test --all-targets (activation fixture failure remains separately reported)
stop_conditions: Do not change the Decapod package version from 0.99.0.
Do not claim Nix hosted proof until GitHub CI runs.
